parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Relations to add to each access list of the answer: one or several of `owner` (the user who created it), `items` (its basic auth users, without passwords) and `clients` (its address rules), separated by commas.

200.description: The access lists, ordered by name

description:
Lists the access lists, ordered by name, each with the number of proxy hosts that use it. A user limited to their own items sees only theirs. The `query` query parameter searches the names. The answers never carry password hashes.

Needs: Access Lists view
